trial_court: Additional District Judge, Patiala, Case No. 7-T under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
case_name: Amardeep Kaur vs Paramjit Singh Chohan
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act for dissolution of marriage by a decree of divorce against her husband. Trial court dismissed the petition. Petitioner appealed.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can mutually agree to dissolve their marriage.
legal_principles.held: It is not possible for the parties to live together as husband and wife so they have decided to dissolved their marriage with mutual consent.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes through mutual agreement.
legal_principles.held: The parties hereby mutually agree that the will make the statement in the High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh, for dissolving their marriage on the grounds of mutual consent.

outcome.final_order: Permission was granted to file petition under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act for dissolving their marriage by mutual consent.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for dissolution of marriage under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act
advising on grounds for divorce in Indian family law
preparing a case for appeal against an order dismissing a petition for divorce
